puzzle_state.summary: Live Trigoku page reachable: Trigoku • Daily Lock | Sapiver Press.

story_note: Isla takes her puzzle to a bookshop cafe corner, where ambient noise and a change of scene shift her rhythm.
continuation_note: Unlike the last two days at the window desk with thoughtful pauses, today Isla changes location mid-session and her stuck moment involves distraction from the environment rather than pure logic hesitation.
facebook_post_text: Took the puzzle to the bookshop today—sometimes a little noise helps you think. https://suite.sapiverpress.co.uk

scenes.scene_description: Isla settles into a corner table at the bookshop cafe, tablet propped against a stack of paperbacks. The hum of conversation and espresso machine creates a soft backdrop.
scenes.caption: Back again.

style_rules: Isla is the only active daily comic character.
Use ISLA_SP trigger word in every image prompt.
Young Black woman, warm medium brown skin, light freckles on nose and cheeks.
Natural coily dark hair in high voluminous puff bun.
Wide floral headband in teal, rust orange, cream, and dusty blue, worn across forehead.
At least 2 of the 6 panels must be front-facing or three-quarter view showing Isla's face clearly.
Puzzle screen must come from a real captured puzzle page.
